paras: The Alpha-N Carbon Rear Diffuser is designed to fit the BMW M2 G87 2023+, and is available in Australia through iilumolab. Developed and manufactured in Germany by Alpha-N Performance, a brand with deep roots in BMW motorsport, this carbon diffuser combines aggressive motorsport aesthetics with OEM-level integration.

The design follows the factory body lines of the M2 to create a more purposeful, performance-oriented rear profile while maintaining a clean, factory-like appearance. The diffuser can be installed as a standalone upgrade or paired with the optional Alpha-N Carbon Rear Underbody Floor Kit for a more complete rear aerodynamic package.
hl: Manufactured in Germany by Alpha-N Performance
Pre-preg 2x2 twill carbon fibre, sourced from Italy
Gloss clear coat with UV protection (matte available on request)
Designed to follow factory G87 M2 body lines
Installs using factory mounting points and clips
Pairs with the Alpha-N Carbon Rear Underbody Floor Kit (sold separately)
ft: Alpha-N Carbon Rear Diffuser for BMW M2 G87 2023+
